subject: [PATCH 5/8] nfsd: give the open file cache its own mutex

2026-09-21.patch_summary: This patch introduces a new mutex, `nfsd_file_cache_mutex`, to protect the open file cache in the NFS server. The existing global mutex, `nfsd_global_mutex`, is left to handle only server start/stop operations, while the new mutex handles cache initialization and teardown, as well as reader and walker access to the cache. This change improves concurrency and reduces lock contention between unrelated namespaces.
